svg.title: AI-Powered Job Search System — Architecture Flowchart
svg.desc: Flowchart showing the full job search system: CLAUDE.md context layer, strategy generation, company packages, job tracking, and WhatsApp automation pipeline for job search and HR contact lookup.
svg.text: Built with Claude Cowork · WhatsApp Automation
CONTEXT LAYER — Persistent Memory (runs automatically every session)
LANE A — Job Search: send "run job search"
LANE B — HR Search: send "run hr search"
OUTPUT FILES — Committed to GitHub · Opened in Claude Cowork
Built by Ankit Agrawal · June 2026 · Claude Cowork + n8n + GitHub Actions + Twilio
